mechanism_narrative: Increasing GDP indicates economic expansion, leading to higher S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: GDP increases but S&P 500 returns are negative over 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: Declining unemployment rate signals economic strength, boosting S&P 500.
failure_condition: UNRATE below 5% but S&P 500 returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales and housing starts indicate strong demand, leading to positive S&P returns.
failure_condition: Both RSAFS and HOUST increase but S&P 500 returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth signals supply strength, leading to higher S&P 500.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 104 but S&P 500 returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts indicate economic growth, boosting S&P 500.
failure_condition: HOUST above 1150 but S&P 500 returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment with high payroll indicates inflation, leading to negative S&P returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE low and PAYEMS high but S&P 500 returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: CPI above threshold indicates inflation, leading to monetary tightening and negative S&P returns.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL above 240 but S&P 500 returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth with low unemployment indicates strong economy, leading to positive S&P returns.
failure_condition: GDP growth and low UNRATE but S&P 500 returns are negative.
